mods.title: HYPNO'S LULLABY REBOOT [Demo]
mods.description:
Boyfriend is missing late at night, and you, Girlfriend, are out looking for him. 

Mind laiden with panic, head swimming with thought
"Oh where could he be? perhaps our favourite spot?"

And as sun met horizon, the night fast encroaching...
A sound from the distance, and slowly approaching.

A call from the fog, a beckoning voice...
Why don't you come closer, you don't have a choice.

"To hell with it" you speak aloud, and advance.
You put one foot forward, and enter my dance...

So into the darkness, and into the black.
Not knowing, or caring, if you'll ever come back.

- - 
Available for Mac, Windows, and Linux!

A demo for the official reboot of the Poképasta mod Hypno's Lullaby V2, FNF Lullaby was passed down to newer leadership, featuring legacy developers still in play. Its been a long time coming to ensure the game is brought back alive, birthed in a new light. I can't help but be proud of each and every single member that contributed and came along with us through the full journey. 

Enter the grand shop that is the Cabinet of Novelties, and aid the ever illustrious Collector in his journey to, well, collect magical artifacts. Your paycheck? Endless entertainment in the form of bootleg cartridges imbued with suffering essence. 

Become a Collectoree! For more information, visit cabinetofnovelties.com.

For those who are struggling with the fangame's mechanics; the Collector offers his services localized in the shop's Console settings under Misc, titled "Baby Mode."

This fangame was made using Rubicon Engine, a Godot FNF Engine.
- - 
For immediate advanced settings:

Windows/Linux
CTRL + ALT + S

Mac
CMD + Option + S

This is a Psych Engine port of the first challenge in FNF ONLINE VS, the Hank Challenge (with the song's name being "Accelerant").

This port is intended to be used with the ONLINE VS. Result Screen Port.

A lot of people have already tried to port this challenge to psych, but most of these ports are rushed, inaccurate, and just stupidly lazy (written before TheConcealedCow made his port, which is very good as well and is definitly worth your time). In this port, however, I tried to put as much effort as I can and I wanted this port to be one of the best psych engine ports to date. I hope you'll enjoy this port as much as I enjoyed making it!

Accelerant REDUX

The offical remix (by philiplol) for Accelerant, "Accelerant REDUX", is playable in this port as an unlockable song. It includes the new song with one difficulty ("madness"), and a few minor visual effects added. This was originally supposed to only be a preview for a full Accelerant REDUX mod, which would have had completely new visuals, animations and cutscenes, a "normal" difficulty and a few new mechanics, but I completely canceled it.

Read the README.md file from this mod's folder if you're looking for more information about this port and the plans I have for its future

mods.title: VS. Mouse Ultimate [INCOMPLETE OFFICIAL RELEASE]

Overview:

A couple from Orlando encounter the hidden remnants of Disney's top-secret "W.O.N.D.E.R Initiative", where the now-bankrupt corporation recklessly attempted to make Mickey Mouse and his friends exist in real life. Their success was... pyrrhic.

About This Game:

Vs. Mouse ULTIMATE is a mod of the hit indie game "Friday Night Funkin'", serving as a complete overhaul of its father mod, "Vs. Mouse", with a fresh twist and a deeper narrative.

This mod is cancelled, but we hope you enjoy what we had in store for you all mouse fans! We love you all so-so much and we spent a LOTTA time on this, and I must say.. it sure ended up beautiful.

  • EPISODE 1 - Clubhouse Catastrophe: BF and GF discover a whole new, hidden world, where they meet Mickey Mouse and his friends! Surely this'll all be fun, right?...
  • FREEPLAY: Legacy Variants of the songs shown off in Episode 1, including a secret song...? Try and find it, no peeking!
  • INTERACTIVE MINIGAMES: Access the Credits Menu to play a fun clicking game! Just simply click the credit icons and you will receive clicks. For your time and dedication, you will also be receiving trophies! Will you be the one to get the rarest and highest one!?
  • CUSTOMIZABLE OPTIONS: Not only are there minigames; you can also customize the options to your liking, including more secrets which were created during the mod's development! Feel free to check it out.

IMPORTANT NOTE:  This project is not directly affiliated with the developers of MOUSE! or Vs. Mouse ROOKIES EDITION. While we share the same base concept, as well as similar inspirations and ideas, we remain separate, individual games. Think of us as creative siblings embarking on parallel adventures! :))

mods.title: FNF: SONIC JAM!

Welcome to SONIC JAM

JAMMIN' NEW WEEK

Take on the World's Most Famous Hedgehog in WEEK SONIC, a 3-song original level with songs inspired by the rich soundtracks of Sonic CD, Sonic R,Sonic Adventure, and beyond! Revisit a classic locale, experience dazzling hand-drawn cutscenes, and rhyme at super-sonic speeds! Can you keep up?

PLAYABLE SONIC CAMPAIGN

Dr. Eggman's got a new path to world domination-- the POWER of MUSIC! Using his greatest creation, METAL SONIC, the Doctor's taking over the city's musical culture to harness its unlimited musical power. What's worse... is that they're convinced METAL SONIC is the REAL SONIC! But Sonic's not the slacker type. Take back the city's music and clear Sonic's name through intricately crafted 'Sonic Mixes' of FNF's unforgettable soundtrack. With 10+ remixes lovingly created from the ground up, you can check out a fresh, distinct take on Friday Night Funkin's music inspired by New Jack Swing, RNB, 90's House, Rock, Hip Hop, Chiptune, and many more. Face off against the worst of the worst, bring Metal Sonic's reign to an end, and free the spirit of music in Sonic's campaign.

GO FOR PERFECT

When you're playing as Sonic, simply hitting all the notes won't be enough for those brag-worthy P ranks. On top of beating a song flawlessly, you'll need to style on your enemies with a brand new taunt system. After hitting a combo, you'll be able to chain taunts to the rhythm until your next turn. Pull off a sweet chain, and you'll get crazy bonuses that'll shoot you straight to the top! Every SICK note you hit gets added to your SCORE, so be sure to rack up enough for a massive score bonus at the end. Make a name for yourself on the charts as the most stylish MC alive!
